countries.reasoning: Based on industry data and chemical production reports from 2023; US is a leading producer with extensive chemical manufacturing capacity. Data from US chemical associations and USGS chemical production estimates give high confidence.
China is a major global chemical producer with significant isopropanol manufacturing. Recent data from Chinese industrial production reports and global chemical market analyses support this figure.

India has growing chemical production capacity reflected in trade and production statistics from 2022-2023. Estimates supported by Indian government and trade sources, though less comprehensive than US/China data.
Germany is a leading European chemical producer with detailed production data from the European chemical industry and VCI (German Chemical Industry Association). Data for 2023 is reliable.
Significant chemical manufacturing hub in Asia with established isopropanol production; data from industry reports and trade statistics support this estimate but with some variability.
